input.title: review: simplify trigger and references
input.body: Use a plain pull_request trigger and track main.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 name: ai-review
 on:
-  pull_request_target:
+  pull_request:
     branches: [main]
 jobs:
   review:
-    uses: some-org/ci-toolkit/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
+    uses: some-org/ci-toolkit/.github/workflows/ai-review.yml@main
     with:
-      toolkit_ref: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
+      toolkit_ref: main
     secrets:
       LLM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.LLM_API_KEY }}

note: Two intended defects, both matched: (1) pull_request trigger puts PR-controlled workflow code in the secret-bearing run; (2) floating refs defeat the immutable-supply-chain review. Nothing else can block.
